title: AccessEnvelopeChangedPayload
description: Payload of `access.envelope.changed` version 1: what the platform withholds from a partner's entitlements changed. The envelope's `partner_id` is the partner. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

partner_id.description: The partner, the same value as the envelope's `partner_id`.

withheld.description: Every permission withheld after the change, sorted.
